title: Contributor reports
hints: Add a `contributor: str | None` field on each session, and keep a secondary index `dict[str, list[str]]` from contributor to their session ids. Indexes like this are the classic move when a new query arrives.
Don't cache elapsed totals per contributor — open sessions keep growing with the clock. Reuse `get_session_elapsed` and sum at query time.
Distinct tasks across sessions: union the per-session task sets: `set().union(*(s.tasks for s in sessions))`.
Sort with a tuple key: `sorted(totals.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))`, then slice `[:n]` and format with an f-string.
